proof_scope: In progress. R1776 promotes the actual dyadic regularity cost to arbitrary Schwartz functions, proves its quadratic homogeneity, and normalizes the jointly selected nonzero band without losing its fixed cost bound, strict average norm ratio, prescribed lower frequency level or exact Fourier annulus. A general C1 translation energy inequality needs only continuous square-integrable derivative, not integrability of the original function. The actual complex L2 Mobius action preserves norms and obeys the verified reversed product order. Translation, inversion conjugation and one fixed translated inversion give upper, lower and tilted unipotent bounds. A three-factor matrix decomposition then proves ||W_g u-u|| <= 29*2^j*sqrt(R)*eta whenever Q_j(u)<=R, eta<=1/2, |g00-1|<=eta, |g01|<=eta and |g10|<=eta. No condition on g11 beyond determinant one is needed. This completes the targeted local perturbation estimate without a separate dilation-flow argument.
